scope: Read-only original Unit source and retained original screenshots/DOM; proposed patch only under stage _reports, no app source edit, no browser/DB/provider action.

observed_failure.actual_pixels: Loaded western US cartography with red marker near Nevada/Sacramento, while title is the fictional vehicle rescue and address says Chicago. The prior inline Static Images preview is Chicago.

confirmed_source_paths.finding: Detail parses call Latitude/Longitude or Geolocation. Both inline StaticMap and FullScreenMap receive the same chosen mapLatitude/mapLongitude. No intentional alternate full-screen destination is present.
Inline map uses Mapbox Static Images HTTP URL constructed directly from supplied longitude/latitude and zoom; it does not exercise the web Camera adapter.
Full screen passes identical [longitude,latitude] to Camera centerCoordinate and PointAnnotation, zoom15. It supplies no MapView initialCenter/initialZoom.
MapView constructor uses optional initialCenter/initialZoom; absent values start at department/fallback center and zoom4. This is separate from the child Camera movement.
Imperative setCamera unconditionally forwards optional zoom/bearing/pitch values, including undefined.
Initial defaultSettings jumpTo and initial controlled jumpTo unconditionally forward optional bearing/pitch (and optional zoom); initialized is marked before jumpTo. Exceptions are swallowed.
Subsequent controlled easeTo/flyTo options also include undefined zoom/bearing/pitch. Rendering/projection guards catch errors but do not make invalid numeric options safe.

Installed MapboxGL3.18.1 jumpTo/easeTo test property presence for numeric camera options. A present undefined bearing/pitch/zoom is numeric-coerced to NaN; an omitted option keeps the existing value. Undefined center is explicitly ignored/falls back to previous position.

probe.limits: Offline tests execute real installed SDK numeric option handling on a minimal map host and actual Camera React effects in jsdom. They do not render cartography or execute easeTo/flyTo animation interpolation. The normal repository Jest setup is currently blocked by missing react-native-permissions; isolated web test harness ran successfully.

diagnosis: A confirmed shared web Camera numeric-option contract defect is sufficient to corrupt camera state despite correct supplied incident coordinates. It strongly matches the observed unchanged fallback framing. This static/offline audit does not establish every runtime cause of the Nevada marker; actual cartography/marker correctness must be retested after an authorized patch.021 remains rejected.

unsaved_create_form_findings.authority: Parent reported live UI input/readback during its separate recording; this audit did not access that browser.
unsaved_create_form_findings.typed_GPS_only: Typing coordinates changes the text form Controller, but not selectedLocation. Opening FullScreenLocationPicker then receives no initialLocation and may use department/fallback/default; that first default view does not establish the typed point was parsed.
unsaved_create_form_findings.GPS_magnifier: searchCoordinates validates/parses input and calls onLocationFound with that exact point even when reverse-geocoding fails. handleLocationSelected sets selectedLocation, latitude, longitude and formats the visible coordinates to6decimal places. A warning means address lookup failed, not that the parsed coordinate was replaced with Nevada.
unsaved_create_form_findings.create_payload: onSubmit uses selectedLocation latitude/longitude and the hidden form latitude/longitude set by the callback. It does not parse the unconfirmed text Controller alone.
safe_normal_UI_boundary: Full-screen picker X calls onClose only. Close without Set Location to avoid changing the form.
Inline LocationPicker has no own Cancel/dismiss button. Leave its map and Confirm Location untouched and scroll past it, or cancel the entire unsaved form through its real Cancel.
Do not choose My Location or accept device permissions. Do not click a wrong-location map to manufacture a point.

Before any authorized Create, read back the real formatted coordinates and fictional address after the real GPS magnifier, preserve narrow recipients, and verify the actual saved detail/location afterward. A wrong interactive map remains a recording gap, never successful location-selection evidence.
